summary: Tractor Supply Company filed an 8-K to report results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held May 14, 2026. Standard matters were voted: election of directors, ratification of Ernst & Young as auditor, and non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation. All director nominees were elected, auditor ratification passed, and say-on-pay was approved. The board also appointed Meg Ham to the Audit Committee. No special situation elements—no M&A, tender, activist, restructuring, or strategic review. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure. No deals, advisors, or risk-arb angle.
